summary.en: A board of twelve pictures rearranges twice, following a layout switch: grid, feature mosaic with the first picture captioned, then a cascade of prints under the headline.
summary.zh: 十二张图的看板跟着布局开关重排两次：网格、首图带说明的拼贴，再到错落的照片阶梯，标题落在空出的位置。

fits: A product that shows many pictures (renders, shots, designs) and offers more than one way to see them (demo, proof, rest).
notFor: Fewer than eight pictures (the grid looks empty); a story about one picture; layouts the product does not have (the switch claims a feature).

intent.en: The viewer sees one set of pictures read three ways, archive, curated and fanned, and believes the product's layouts are a real feature.
intent.zh: 让观众看到同一批图有三种看法（档案、精选、摊开），相信“多种布局”是产品真有的能力。

content.en: 8–12 pictures or screenshots (subjects near the centre), three layout names (≤ 8 chars, Chinese ≤ 3 characters), a header, a featured caption and a headline (≤ 28 chars, Chinese ≤ 12).
content.zh: 8–12 张图或截图（主体靠中间），三个布局名（≤ 8 字符、中文 ≤ 3 字），页眉、精选图注和一个标题（≤ 28 字符、中文 ≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 展示大量图片（渲染、镜头、设计）并提供不止一种看法的产品。

notFor.zh: 不到八张图（网格显空）；只讲一张图的故事；产品没有的布局（开关等于宣称有这个功能）。

en: The layouts on the switch must exist in the product; the switch claims them.
Portrait prints crop landscape pictures to a strip: keep subjects near the centre.
zh: 开关上的布局必须产品真有；开关就是在宣称它。
竖幅相纸会把横图裁成中间一条：主体放中间。

upstream.name: 三段布局重排
upstream.summary: 12 张瓦片在规则网格、feature mosaic、对角瀑布串三种排版间连续变形，位置宽高各自插值、逐片微错峰，段间留 hold
upstream.use: "同一批内容多种看法"的陈列转场：作品集/模板库/相册产品的布局能力展示
upstream.energy: 中（连续流动的重排，无爆点，气质从容）

overlaps.note: layout-morph is one change of layout; gallery-reframe chains two of them behind a visible switch, adds the caption, the header and the headline
